description: Serialize data as JSON using the application's json.dumps method if `current_app` is available; otherwise, use the default `json.dumps` method from the `json` module.

The 'template-rendered' signal allows handlers to execute actions after a template rendering is completed in Flask.
The 'before-render-template' signal allows handlers to execute actions before a template rendering begins in Flask.
The 'request-started' signal indicates the initiation of a request processing cycle in Flask.
The 'request-finished' signal indicates the completion of request processing in Flask.
The 'request-tearing-down' signal indicates that the context of a request is being torn down in Flask.
The 'got-request-exception' signal indicates that an exception arose during request handling in Flask.
The 'appcontext-tearing-down' signal indicates that the application context is being destroyed in Flask.
The 'appcontext-pushed' signal indicates that a new application context has been created and is now active in Flask.
The 'appcontext-popped' signal indicates that the current application context has been removed in Flask.
The 'message-flashed' signal indicates that a notification message has been sent to the user in Flask.
